scope: Root supplemental straight-alpha SDL run composition fix only, not complete shaping implementation
reasoning: Script runs measured and rendered using same font/style/direction; disjoint horizontal placement advances by measured run width on a cleared RGBA32 target.

SDL_BLENDMODE_NONE on each rendered run copies straight RGB plus coverage alpha instead of blending coverage into RGB on transparent destination, avoiding double attenuation on later ordinary alpha draw.
Part and composite surfaces are destroyed on blend-mode/blit failure; part is destroyed on success.
Real-font regression scans Devanagari and Latin partial-alpha pixels for exact requested RGB 173/211/239, and requires partial-alpha pixels exist, directly catching premature RGB attenuation.
limits: Static independent review only; parent owns C++ test execution and browser/native images.
